basic.displayNameTooltip: A human-readable name; it does not have to be unique. The task name (the K8s resource name) is generated from it automatically: lowercased, non-alphanumeric characters converted to -, Chinese characters dropped, plus a random suffix.
basic.taskNameTooltip: The final K8s resource name = sanitize(display name) + 10 random characters. It is generated automatically and cannot be edited (this keeps it unique in K8s and Kueue, and logs are located by it).
basic.taskNameRequired: Enter a display name to generate the task name.
basic.taskNamePattern: Lowercase letters, digits and -; must start with a letter; 3-63 characters.
basic.descriptionTooltip: A short description (optional), to help you recognize it in the list and details.

image.help: Choose from the images under "Asset Management → Image" whose purpose includes inference, or type any full image URI (including the tag). Dynamo multi-node inference needs the EFA variant of sglang-runtime (nvcr.io/nvidia/ai-dynamo/sglang-runtime:*-efa-amd64). Private ECR is only supported in the AWS account and Region this platform runs in.
image.label: Image (full name, including tag)
image.empty: If the Image Hub has no images, you can use the default Dynamo sglang-runtime image directly, or register a custom image under <registry>"Asset Management → Image"</registry>.
image.hint: The dropdown lists images under "Image" whose purpose includes inference; you can also type any image URI.

launch.heading: Launch script (Dynamo · sglang)
launch.help:
The whole script runs via /bin/sh -c (the backend renders command=["/bin/sh","-c"], args=[script]).
Use exec to take over the main process. --model-path is required (FSx is mounted at /fsx, so write /fsx/).
Edit the multi-node tensor/expert parallelism flags --tp-size / --ep-size directly here.
launch.scriptExtra: The dynamo.sglang launch command is pre-filled; edit --model-path / --tp-size / --ep-size as needed
